items.question: Does submitting a request create an account?
items.answer: No. You only send a join request. After review, the Watfil team creates the company account manually.

items.question: How long does the review take?
items.answer: Our team reviews requests as soon as possible and will contact you using the details you provided.

items.question: What happens after approval?
items.answer: Once approved, your company account is created and you can start listing products on Watfil.
